title: Universal Banker
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Descriptor**


Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6\.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day\-to\-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

 **Job Introduction**


The Universal Banker (UB) role within HSBC's International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) is pivotal in executing a multiyear growth strategy. This strategy is centered on positioning HSBC as a global bank committed to India's long\-term growth story, leveraging its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for expansion, with plans to add 20 more branches to its existing fleet of 26 branches. The Universal Banker will play a crucial customer\-facing role, servicing primarily walk\-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. This role is integral to delivering effective branch customer interface functions in the front office and teller areas, aligning with the TCF principles to transition from mere transaction processing to need\-based sales.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Ensure effective delivery of branch customer interface functions to achieve high levels of customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
* Implement TCF principles in daily customer interactions, transitioning from transaction processing to need\-based sales.
* Maintain branch hygiene standards by ensuring promotional materials are correctly displayed and the banking hall and ATMs are clean.
* Manage customer complaints and escalations to ensure a positive customer experience.
* Migrate customers to alternate delivery channels in a friendly manner.
* Adhere to operational standards set by the bank, maintaining control over customer deliverables and implementing audit recommendations.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross\-selling opportunities.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements**

* Graduate degree
* Experience ranging 1 – 2 years

**Other Requirements (Knowledge and Experience)**

* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes within the bank.
* Sound understanding of the company's customer service requirements.
* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Ability to establish mutual respect and trust in dealing with others, working effectively as part of a team.
* Demonstrated business focus and customer orientation, providing exemplary service.
* Awareness of AML risk and adherence to regulatory guidelines and internal AML \& Sanction Policy.
* Ability to manage and fulfill customer requirements to their satisfaction, ensuring a positive customer experience consistently.

**Skills**

* **Exceptional Communication Skills:** Ability to convey information clearly and effectively across various channels.
* **Strong Interpersonal Skills:** Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
* **Highly Organized:** Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and efficient task management.
* **Collaborative Team Player:** Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* **Proactive and Efficient:** Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

 **Regulatory Certifications:**

* FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding

 **Pro\-tip :** Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.

* *Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.*

 *As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.*

  

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.


Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Admission Counsellor
description:
**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF A COUNSELLOR** 

**Attributes of a Counselor** 

* The Admission counselor should be a graduate with good communication skills in English and the regional language.
* She is the first person parents meet when they come to a EuroKids school. She should be formally dressed and presentable.
* She should be empathetic, courteous and have a professional approach while interacting with the enquiries.
* She should be aware of the product and present it in a proper sequence using simple language.
* Being alert and proactive is essential for a counselor.

**Roles and responsibilities of a counselor** 

* The counselor is responsible for the front office wherein she counsels prospective parents and maintains all the records related to enquiry.
* She should report to the school 30 minutes prior to the commencement of the first batch.
* She should be familiar with all the policies related to fee structure and admissions etc. and implement them.
* The counselor should be aware of the Happiness kit components and explain it to the parents.
* She should give a patient listening to parents.
* She should ensure that all the essentials of the waiting area should be well placed and the displays should be attractive and relevant.
* She should be responsible for the fee collection and preparation of reports pertaining to inquiries and fee payments.

**Roles and Responsibilities Post counseling** 

* Entering the details in EPMS
* Instant acknowledgement and auto generated messages are sent to parents for a few days
* EPMS entries save the counselor from additional paper work and also helps in understanding conversion rate
* Making a note of first follow\-up date
* Recording the response and action plan
* Filing the admission forms
* Convey all communications related to POP to the enquiries well in time.
* Inviting enquiries for grand celebrations like Annual Day and Sports Day etc.

**Prerequisites of counseling** 

* Reception and waiting area should be well organized with relevant information and right kind of displays.
* Work Station\- reception desk should be clutter free, all the collaterals like brochures, pamphlets and admission forms should be handy.

**While Handling Telephonic Enquiries** 

* The counselor should answer the telephone within two rings \& greet the caller.
* She should excuse herself to take the call if in the middle of a walk\-in counseling.
* She should respond well to the queries and fill up the complete details of the caller in the enquiry record book.
* She should thank the caller for calling and invite him/ her over to the school.
* She should end the call positively and let the caller hang up first.

**While Handling Walk\-in Enquiries** 

**Stage I: Meet \& Greet**

* Greet and make the parent comfortable.
* Listen to his/her queries and respond appropriately explaining about EuroKids preschools.
* Make a note of the child and parents details in the enquiry form.
* File the physical copy of enquiry form.

**Stage ll: Tour of the school**

* Start with the Reception Area, Wash Rooms, Fun Rooms, Pantry, Library, Outdoor Area etc.
* Talk about the safe environment, Fire Extinguishers, CCTV cameras, displays, group activities, usage of puppet theatres, sand \& water play areas.
* Talk about the outdoor and indoor equipment and other offerings.
* Talk about the Key Differentiators of EuroKids

**Stage Ill: Share Information** 

* Counselling Tool
* Doctor on call, Safe school certified, and First aid Box.
* Talk about in\-house training for teachers \& support staff.
* Field trips.

**Stage lV \& V: Share Fee Details \& Closure** 

* Show the approved fee structure along with the bifurcation.
* Ensure that the parent buys the admission form.
* Explain the payment terms \& conditions.
* End the conversation with a thank you and visit again note.

**While Handling Online Enquiry** 

* Conduct a telephonic enquiry
* Invite the parent for a Video conferencing session.
* Follow the process of Walk in enquiry handling.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* total work: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Store Manager
description:
**Company:** Aqua Plus  
**Position:** Store Manager  
**Experience:** Fresher to 2 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Working Hours:** 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM

**About the Role**

Aqua Plus is looking for a responsible and customer\-focused **Store Manager** to manage day\-to\-day store operations, maintain inventory, handle customer enquiries, and generate sales from walk\-in customers.

The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, be comfortable interacting with customers, and have the ability to understand and explain different water purifier models, their features, benefits, and suitability according to customer requirements.

**Key ResponsibilitiesStore Management**

* Manage the day\-to\-day operations of the Aqua Plus store.
* Ensure the store is clean, organized, and properly maintained.
* Maintain daily stock records of water purifiers, filters, spare parts, and other products.
* Update incoming and outgoing stock on a daily basis.
* Monitor stock levels and inform the management when products or parts need to be reordered.
* Maintain accurate inventory and store\-related records.
* Coordinate with the service/technician team whenever required.

**Customer Handling \& Sales**

* Welcome and assist walk\-in customers at the store.
* Understand customer requirements, budget, and water purification needs.
* Explain the features, benefits, specifications, and pricing of different water purifier models.
* Help customers compare available models and select a suitable product.
* Handle customer questions and objections professionally.
* Follow up with interested customers when required.
* Convert walk\-in enquiries into successful sales.
* Maintain a positive and professional customer experience.

**Customer Data Management**

* Collect and maintain customer information for every relevant enquiry and purchase.
* Maintain accurate records of customer name, contact details, product interest, purchase information, and follow\-up status.
* Regularly update customer data and ensure records are properly maintained.
* Coordinate with the service team regarding installation or service requirements after a sale.

**Sales Incentives**

In addition to the fixed monthly salary, **performance\-based incentives will be provided for successful in\-store customer conversions**.

The incentive structure will be explained during the interview.

**Eligibility \& Requirements**

* Fresher to 2 years of experience in retail, sales, store management, or a similar role.
* **Hindi communication is mandatory.**
* Good verbal communication and customer\-handling skills.
* Should be confident while interacting with customers.
* Ability to understand and explain product features clearly.
* Basic computer knowledge for maintaining stock and customer records.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets will be an advantage.
* Should be organized and responsible with inventory and customer data.
* Sales\-oriented mindset with the ability to convert customer enquiries into sales.
* Willingness to learn about water purifiers and their technical features.
* Must be punctual, disciplined, and professional.

**Working Hours**

**10:00 AM to 7:00 PM**

**Working Days:** As per Aqua Plus store schedule.

**What We Offer**

* Fixed monthly salary
* Performance\-based sales incentives
* Opportunity to develop sales and store\-management skills
* Product training on different water purifier models
* Opportunity for career growth within Aqua Plus

Pay: ₹8,500\.00 \- ₹12,000\.00 per month

description:
**About the Role**:


Wolters Kluwer is seeking a motivated and talented professional as an Xactly Product Development Internal Consultant (Analyst) to join a newly created Incentive Compensation \& Planning COE that will support 5 core divisions, approximately 55 subsidiaries, and 3,000\+ sellers across 140\+ countries. The COE will partner with the various Divisions \& Business Units while remaining a strong partner to the Sales Transformation team within the Corporate Strategy, Innovation, and M\&A Group.


In this role, you will have an exciting opportunity to develop new capabilities in Xactly that will drive operational excellence to Sales, Sales Ops, Finance, HR, and other partnering functions to Incentive Compensation \& Planning. Your role will act as an internal technical consultant responsible for configuring core Comp Plans \& Incentives as well as partnering with Sales Transformation and other cross\-functional stakeholders to ideate \& develop scalable solutions that drives sales performance excellence and ultimately boosts revenue.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop solutions in Xactly to modernize internal operations that drive business value, efficiency, etc. Xactly's R\&D and product enhancements across Extend, Connect \& Reporting have opened new opportunities to get creative and scale solutions that were never possible in the past
* Support and/or develop processes to govern data models, security, and retention across the sales compensation program's ecosystem
* Develop and implement advanced and adoptable processes, modernized functionality, and ensure global technical preparedness for all global commissions systems (7\-8 Xactly instances)
* Support strategic projects to enhance efficiency and effectiveness
* Support Xactly Administrators and Analytics teams to resolve challenges for the business to operative effectively
* Oversee configuration and development deployments across environments and instances
* Support the broader Xactly COE in driving value to the organization, including key partnerships with the COE Analytics, Administration and Change Management \& Governance teams, as well as peers in the Xactly development team
* Assess, configure, and deploy commission/incentive plans, workflows and custom apps (in Xactly Extend)

**Skills \& Experiences:**

* 2\+ years in Sales Comp related responsibilities with knowledge of Xactly modules
* Bachelor's degree in business, Finance, or a related field
* Xactly Administrator and Plan Configuration Certification(s), or ability to obtain after onboarding
* Proven experience in sales compensation administration, governance, and/or technical design, with an understanding of compensation methodologies and functional best practices.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to generate insightful analytics from complex data
* Strong interpersonal skills, capable of building relationships across various teams.
* Experience managing and/or dispositioning incentive compensation related disputes \& inquiries; or ability to interpret challenges from the sales organization and synthesize challenges while considering policies and processes.
* Ability to identify root causes of common disputes/inquiries or other related challenges, then recommending/delivering process/policy/technology changes that strengthen operational excellence.
* Proven experience calculating commissions and generating payroll submission files.
* Ability to think strategically while considering tactical implications.
* Strong Hands on with PowerPoint and Excel
* Coding: SQL (beginner to intermediate)

**Nice to Have:**

* Certifications from other ICM systems (i.e. Varicent, SAP\-Callidus)
* Sales Operation/Sales Admin experience across industry

**Our Interview Practices**

title: Senior Manager, System Operation and Administrator
description:
Every day, Global Payments makes it possible for millions of people to move money between buyers and sellers using our payments solutions for credit, debit, prepaid and merchant services. Our worldwide team helps over 3 million companies, more than 1,300 financial institutions and over 600 million cardholders grow with confidence and achieve amazing results. We are driven by our passion for success and we are proud to deliver best\-in\-class payment technology and software solutions. Join our dynamic team and make your mark on the payments technology landscape of tomorrow.


**Summary of This Role**
------------------------


Manages the operation, maintenance and administration of the organization's operating and management systems so that they function reliably, meet the organization's business needs, and use the organization's IT resources effectively. Oversees activities relating to technical guidance for planning, directing, and monitoring operating systems. Plans and recommends operating system modifications or additional equipment to increase the capacity of the system. Prepares operational cost estimates for current and proposed plans. Evaluates vendor proposals for purchases of hardware.

**What Part Will You Play?**
----------------------------

* Provides leadership for all aspects of a global multi\-data center environment. Coordinates the planning, acquisition, implementation, and support of systems deployed globally. Evaluates new technologies for optimal operational value and quality of service. Ensures compliance with regulatory and audit standards set forth by the Statement on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE) No.16, Service Organization Controls Report (SOC1\), Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC), client contracts and other relevant standards. Ensures system security standards to protect customer data against unauthorized access.
* Plans and directs global capacity management activities to ensure systems are appropriately sized and configured to support customer needs. Establishes and supervises the collection of analytics used for capacity analysis to accurately forecast future resource utilization requirements. Produces annual capacity plan and contribute to budget development, to support required infrastructure enhancements. Ensures scalability and accessibility of applications or services.
* Leads infrastructure change process for a global card authorizations environment. Ensures that change is consistently\-executed, with no interruptions to service. Provides technical leadership of group incident resolution process and root cause analysis. Facilitates large changes and other high\-risk activity. Manages monitoring of other teams' changes when requested.
* Leads the development and support of a disaster recovery and business continuity solution, to support a critical business service. Evaluates new technology to decrease recovery times and simplify recovery solutions. Executes recovery of the production environment to an out of region facility, within contractual time frames.
* Facilitates vendor relationships with major hardware and software providers, including problem management, enhancements, and support. Monitors vendor performance, products, and services. Participates in vendor events which focus on future products and services, industry trends, vendor strategic direction and similar topics. Meets regularly with internal staff to keep apprised of strategic direction and how it would be supported by current and future vendor relationships.
* Collaborates and provides recommendations to executive leadership on technology related issues. Engages global internal business partners to understand their support needs and coordinate the development of infrastructure to maintain relevant services as the payments environment evolves. Communicates effectively with current and prospective clients to align business needs with technical solutions. Coaches team members to effectively engage clients and to provide industry\-best technical solutions.
* Not an exhaustive list; other duties as assigned.

**What Are We Looking For in This Role?**
-----------------------------------------

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree, Relevant Experience or Degree in: related field of study from an accredited university is required; however, relevant experience in lieu of a degree may be considered.
* Typically a minimum of 8 years related professional experience including a minimum of 3\-4 years experience in a supervisory position.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* None Identified

-------------------------------------------------

Exercises full supervision in terms of staffing, work and performance management, salary decisions, training and development, and disciplinary issues.

title: Senior System Administrator
